events.title: ANE data-processing technicians strike over unpaid wages

events.excerpt: suite à une grève des informaticiens du centre de traitement des données.
events.notes: TV5MONDE says election-result announcement planned for May3 was postponed following the strike and technicians demanded two months’ arrears. Africanews/AFP also reported the strike. The strike onset may predate May3; range is a cautious reporting window.

excluded_or_unverified_leads.reason: Official report describes a pre-Labor-Day sporting/fitness march in Bangui, not a demonstration of dissent.
Official results describe a labor holiday celebration, not a protest occurrence.

method_notes: Bounded search for strikes, public protests, demonstrations, rallies and mobilizations physically inside the country during Apr-Jun 2026.
Local-language queries were used where feasible: Portuguese for Cape Verde, French for Chad and Central African Republic, Spanish for Chile; English companion queries included.
No-results is not an absence claim. Planned or canceled actions and non-dissent civic/sporting marches are not counted as protest events.
Publication date, event date and precision are separated; exact URLs and source provenance retained.
Provisional staging only; no scientific-kit integration or canonical schema validation performed.
